💜 Sharing this as a quick financial education resource for families in our community.

I’m Alma Nava, a Financial Educator, and I help families better understand financial protection, life insurance, retirement, and legacy planning.

I put together this simple checklist of 5 areas every family should consider. Take a look and see where you stand.

If you have questions or would like a complimentary Financial Protection Review, feel free to message me. I’d be happy to connect. 💜
